{{Quote|Revaak's men are the toughest mercs on the planet. They'll outnumber you--and the vault's defenses are also considerable.|[[Cathan Dru]]|<ref name="TOR:SA" />}}
'''Revaak's mercenaries''' were a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They were hired by the Republic to guard the [[Steelfast Data Haven]].<ref name="TOR:SA" />
